issue_context.title: ONVIF Camera integration broken in my case
issue_context.body:
## The problem I have a slight problem with the new ONVIF snapshotting after #33149 and #33241. I reenabled my camera and the Lovelace tile does not show any snapshot BUT the live camera on click works fine. It's no anonymous ONVIF login btw. If I try to call the snapshot service directly the resulting "image" is no image, but a HTML site... ``` 404 Not Found

404 Not Found

nginx/1.15.3
``` Thus my automation sending that image to my Telegram Bot fails too. All my pastes will show the working FFMPEG camera connecting to the same device as reference. ## Environment - Home Assistant Core release with the issue: 0.108.0b5 - Last working Home Assistant Core release (if known): 0.107.7 - Operating environment (Home Assistant/Supervised/Docker/venv): HASSIO x86_64 - Integration causing this issue: ONVIF Camera - Link to integration documentation on our website: https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/onvif/ ## Problem-relevant `configuration.yaml` ```yaml - platform: onvif host: 192.168.181.27 port: 8000 username: admin password: PASSWORD profile: 1 extra_arguments: -q:v 3 - platform: ffmpeg input: rtsp://admin:PASSWORD@192.168.181.27:8554/Streaming/Channels/101 ``` ## Traceback/Error logs Sadly no log entries... ## Additional information ![cam problem](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/29841368/78706801-f3349000-790f-11ea-9fff-a7a39c33ebeb.PNG)
comments: Before I forget. The special case is a camera from a Chinese (what else ^^) company called Zeetopin (http://www.zeetopin.net/ENGLISH/ the right one) and if you look more closely it's a relabled Meari Speed 5S.
Same issue here, it seems some onvif camera does not have full integrations. in my case Sricam SP009A does not manage the date/time check that has been add in the latest release.
@roleoroleo looks like your https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/33149 introduced an issue. Could you take a look?
I have a potential fix https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/33865, if someone could try it?
Moved the component into custom_components with your fix and it seems to work quite fine. Telegram bot back on ONVIF cam works and Lovelace looks good too.

Tested on my cam as a custom_components.
It works correctly using http.

review_comments: The fetch function has inconsistent return values. We should `return None` explicitly in the two other exits of this function.
